systems.country_label: WAPIS; national Data Collection and Registration Centre (DACORE)
systems.owner: Programme funded by the European Union and implemented by INTERPOL with the ECOWAS Commission
systems.tiers: A national data centre: Niger is listed among the eight countries whose centre was in operation before Togo's opened on 29 April 2022; the programme's next phase is to extend the system beyond the DACOREs; data entry clerks and validators are named as DACORE roles

systems.owner: WAPIS Programme (INTERPOL); UNDP keen to support an extension to the Ministry of Justice
systems.tiers: First training of magistrates and judicial staff in Niamey during a mission of 20 to 24 June 2022: five clerks of the Niamey Regional Court, a deputy attorney-general, an investigating judge and two other magistrates; IOM to support connecting border points
Named as the channel through which national centres share data; nothing specific to Niger

note: For Niger the newsletter reports an operating national centre and training of court staff; it does not say that stations enter their reports or cases in WAPIS, so the typology gives the system no class and it yields no fact.
